events.description: Multiple police officers in riot gear physically assault and forcibly remove civilians from a stairwell, including dragging, pushing, and striking individuals who appear restrained or non-resisting.
Physical struggle occurs between civilians and police officers on the stairs; some civilians actively resist (pushing, grabbing), while officers use force to subdue and remove them.

A chaotic, violent confrontation unfolds in an indoor stairwell involving multiple riot police and a group of civilians, with sustained physical force, crowd compression, and loss of control—meeting criteria for collective violent unrest.

A violent clash occurs inside a confined indoor space (likely a polling station) between multiple riot police officers in full protective gear and a crowd of civilians. Officers are seen pushing, grabbing, and forcibly moving individuals; some civilians are on the floor while others resist or intervene. The scene shows sustained chaotic physical confrontation, with repeated use of force by police against a densely packed group.

At least two officers are seen actively subduing a person lying on the floor near a green door (frame f7–f8), with one officer appearing to strike or press down on the individual’s head/upper body while the person is in a vulnerable, supine position. The victim does not appear to be resisting at that moment, indicating a helpless state.

Mutual physical combat is visible: civilians (including a woman in blue jacket, frame f2–f5) are actively pushing back against officers, grabbing arms, and attempting to block or pull officers away. One civilian raises a red pole-like object (possibly a railing segment) in a defensive/offensive posture (f3–f5). This indicates reciprocal engagement, not one-sided force alone.

A chaotic confrontation inside a confined space (likely a polling station) involving multiple uniformed riot police officers in helmets and body armor engaging with a dense crowd of civilians. Officers are seen pushing, grabbing, and attempting to clear or disperse the crowd; civilians are resisting, falling, and being subdued on the floor. The scene shows sustained violent group unrest with physical clashes, consistent with a riot.

At least one individual (e.g., person in green shirt, later seen on floor at f2–f5) is restrained and pushed to the ground by multiple officers while appearing unable to effectively resist, constituting abuse of a helpless victim during the broader riot. Officers use force against individuals who are already down or being held by others.

Mutual physical combat occurs between some civilians and officers: e.g., at f10–f13, a man in green shirt actively pushes back against officers, grabs an officer’s arm, and appears to exchange blows; other civilians raise arms defensively or offensively. This indicates reciprocal aggression beyond one-sided restraint.

A chaotic confrontation between riot police in full protective gear and a dense crowd of civilians inside a building (likely a polling station), involving pushing, shoving, and physical struggle; multiple officers advance into the crowd while civilians resist or are displaced.
A woman in a light-colored coat is forcibly grabbed and pulled down by multiple officers in riot gear; she appears off-balance and unable to resist as they lift and drag her through the crowd.

Mutual physical struggle occurs: a man in a green shirt actively resists police by gripping a red pole/rod and pushing back against officers; other civilians also engage physically with officers, indicating reciprocal combat rather than one-sided restraint.

Multiple police officers in riot gear physically assault and drag a person (initially with light-colored hair, later a person in white hoodie) on the ground near a green door; the victim appears restrained and unable to resist while being struck and pulled.

A chaotic physical struggle occurs between multiple individuals including police officers and civilians near the green doorway; at least one civilian is grabbed and pushed, indicating mutual or contested physical engagement before the victim becomes subdued.

A violent group confrontation involving multiple riot police and civilians in a confined space, characterized by coordinated force deployment, crowd compression, and repeated use of physical coercion against individuals, consistent with a riotous incident.
Multiple police officers in riot gear physically assault a person on the ground near a green door; the individual is restrained, struck, and appears helpless throughout the sequence.

A person wearing a green backpack actively resists and struggles against multiple officers attempting to subdue them at the doorway; visible pushing, grabbing, and defensive movements indicate mutual physical engagement before the person is brought down.

A chaotic scene with multiple uniformed officers in full riot gear engaging several civilians in close-quarters physical confrontation near a building entrance; presence of crowd, rapid movement, and coordinated force suggests collective violent unrest.

A dense crowd of protesters confronts a line of riot police in full protective gear; there is sustained physical pushing, shoving, and close-quarters struggle between the two groups, with officers using batons and some individuals raising hands defensively or aggressively. The scene shows collective violent unrest with no clear separation between groups.

Multiple individuals in the crowd engage in direct physical combat with police officers: grabbing, pulling, striking, and resisting. A person in a blue jacket is repeatedly pushed and restrained by several officers while others around them grapple with officers. Mutual physical engagement is visible across frames.

A person in a blue jacket appears restrained and overwhelmed by multiple officers, with arms raised and body compressed; officers use batons near the individual while they are in a vulnerable position (e.g., bent over, surrounded). This suggests disproportionate force against a partially helpless individual during the melee.

A violent clash between a group of protesters and a line of riot police in full protective gear, involving pushing, shoving, and physical contact; the crowd is densely packed and actively engaging with officers.

A protester in a blue jacket is visibly restrained and pushed to the ground by multiple officers while others surround and press in; the individual appears unable to resist or move freely during this period.
Mutual physical combat occurs between multiple individuals in the crowd and police officers, including grabbing, striking, and wrestling motions observed across frames.
